name: Northside Duology Part 1 2022
information: ![](https://i.imgur.com/ZIPeEfV.png) This is a series competition with [Northside Duology Part 2 2022](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/NorthsideDuologyPart22022). You may register for **ONLY ONE** competition in the series. If you register for both, your registration will only be accepted for one of the competitions. Please note that each competition has a different set of events. If you feel sick, stay at home. If you are exhibiting cold or flu-like symptoms consistent with COVID-19, you will not be permitted in the venue. We are not responsible for any illness you may contract from the competition. **Contact us** We are on [Facebook](https://www.facebook.com/SpeedcubingAustralia/) and [Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/speedcubingau/)!
